verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a document-based trail rather than an audit log. Every cap table change automatically collects its resulting documents in the data room, and grants are smart-linked to the board consent that authorized them, which covers the 'under what authorization' element. Board and stockholder approvals are built into every relevant workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit change/audit log recording who made each edit and when, field-level before/after history, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
